issue.title: docker manifests assume the rm command (introduced in 20.10)
issue.body:
**Describe the bug**
The code starts off with trying to remove an non-existent manifest in https://github.com/goreleaser/goreleaser/blob/df1ea4851ad1ea5afb323c1213ca6648ef2637f5/internal/pipe/docker/manifest.go#L88-L97 however, the `rm ` command is only available in 20.10. This normally would not be a prpblem but for various reasons, I have to build on Debian stretch which does not package 20.10. The last version available is 19.03 which does not have the rm command.

Shoehorning 20.10 into stretch appears to be a problem I suspect that the GLIBC version 2.28 in buster is required for 20.10. 

**To Reproduce**

Define `docker` and `docker_manifest` sections
Run goreleaser

The actual goreleaser config I use if quite voluminous but I am including it to show how constricted my options are:
